items.title: Welcome to your work queue
items.ask: PWQ is where Iter proposes work and you answer with clicks. To try it, pick how Iter should handle decisions it can't make alone:
items.proposed_shape: Iter asks small questions directly in chat, and uses PWQ for bigger work proposals like this one.

options.label: A — Ask me in chat
options.desc: Small questions go to chat; PWQ stays for work items

options.label: B — Everything through PWQ
options.desc: Even small questions become queue items you answer with clicks

options.label: C — Decide alone
options.desc: Iter decides small things itself; PWQ only for big choices
